messages.speaker: arjun.malhotra@veridian-corp.example
messages.text: Neha, where are we on the Q3 campaign deck?

messages.speaker: neha.kapoor@veridian-corp.example
messages.text: Draft is 80% done. I'll send it to Arjun for review by Wednesday.

messages.speaker: arjun.malhotra@veridian-corp.example
messages.text: I told Raghav I'd send him the updated vendor list. I'll get that to him by end of day tomorrow.

messages.speaker: raghav.sethi@veridian-corp.example
messages.text: Appreciated. Separately, the Mumbai office renewal paperwork needs someone to sign off this week. Not sure whose desk that's on right now.

messages.speaker: divya.rao@veridian-corp.example
messages.text: I think that's supposed to be Facilities, but I haven't seen anyone pick it up.

messages.speaker: arjun.malhotra@veridian-corp.example
messages.text: Okay, flag it, don't assume. Divya, can you also pull the July expense variance report before Thursday's board prep?

messages.speaker: divya.rao@veridian-corp.example
messages.text: Yes, I'll have it ready Wednesday evening.

messages.speaker: arjun.malhotra@veridian-corp.example
messages.text: One more thing — client call with Meridian Logistics got pushed. I need to reconfirm the new time with their team myself.

messages.speaker: neha.kapoor@veridian-corp.example
messages.text: Also, just a reminder, the campaign deck review — I said Wednesday, but realistically Thursday morning is safer.

messages.speaker: arjun.malhotra@veridian-corp.example
messages.text: Quick note to self — need to get Raghav that vendor list, I think I said today but it might slip to tomorrow morning, remind me. Also still haven't heard back on the Mumbai lease thing, someone needs to own that, I don't think it's me.

messages.speaker: arjun.malhotra@veridian-corp.example
messages.text: Reminder — expense variance report from Divya needs to be in my hands by Wednesday evening, not Thursday, I want time to go through it before board prep. Also Meridian call — I owe Priya a time, need to lock that in today.

messages.speaker: raghav.sethi@veridian-corp.example
messages.text: Following up from the sync — can you send the updated vendor list today?

messages.speaker: arjun.malhotra@veridian-corp.example
messages.text: Running behind, will send first thing tomorrow morning instead.

messages.speaker: raghav.sethi@veridian-corp.example
messages.text: No worries, whenever you get a chance today works.

messages.speaker: arjun.malhotra@veridian-corp.example
messages.text: Sorry, got pulled into board prep — will send by tomorrow (Wednesday) morning for sure.

messages.speaker: raghav.sethi@veridian-corp.example
messages.text: Just checking — still good for this morning?

messages.speaker: neha.kapoor@veridian-corp.example
messages.text: Deck's coming together, still targeting Wednesday for your review.

messages.speaker: neha.kapoor@veridian-corp.example
messages.text: Heads up — shifting the review to Thursday morning instead of Wednesday, need one more day on the data slides.

messages.speaker: arjun.malhotra@veridian-corp.example
messages.text: Understood, Thursday morning works. What time exactly?

messages.speaker: neha.kapoor@veridian-corp.example
messages.text: Let's say 9:30 AM Thursday, before your board prep block.

messages.speaker: neha.kapoor@veridian-corp.example
messages.text: Deck is ready, attaching the draft ahead of our 9:30 review.

messages.speaker: priya.nair@meridianlogistics.example
messages.text: Our scheduled call this week got bumped from our side — can you propose a new time? We're flexible Tuesday-Thursday afternoons.

messages.speaker: arjun.malhotra@veridian-corp.example
messages.text: Apologies for the delay — how about Wednesday 3:00 PM?

messages.speaker: priya.nair@meridianlogistics.example
messages.text: Wednesday 3 PM works on our end, confirmed.

messages.speaker: priya.nair@meridianlogistics.example
messages.text: Quick check — still on for 3 PM today?

messages.speaker: arjun.malhotra@veridian-corp.example
messages.text: Yes, confirmed, see you at 3.

messages.speaker: divya.rao@veridian-corp.example
messages.text: Starting on the July variance numbers, targeting Thursday morning for board prep as discussed.

messages.speaker: arjun.malhotra@veridian-corp.example
messages.text: Actually, can I get it by Wednesday evening instead? Want time to review before Thursday.

messages.speaker: divya.rao@veridian-corp.example
messages.text: Wednesday evening is tight but doable, I'll prioritize it.

messages.speaker: divya.rao@veridian-corp.example
messages.text: Report attached, sent as promised.

messages.speaker: arjun.malhotra@veridian-corp.example
messages.text: Got it, thank you — exactly what I needed before tomorrow.

messages.speaker: facilities@veridian-corp.example
messages.text: Reminder: the Mumbai office lease renewal requires an authorized signature by Friday, 25 September.

messages.speaker: raghav.sethi@veridian-corp.example
messages.text: Following up from the sync — has anyone confirmed who's signing off on the Mumbai renewal? Don't think it's been assigned.

messages.speaker: divya.rao@veridian-corp.example
messages.text: Not on my end — I believe this typically sits with Facilities directly, not us.

messages.speaker: facilities@veridian-corp.example
messages.text: Second reminder: signature is still pending. Deadline is Friday, 25 September, end of day.

messages.speaker: raghav.sethi@veridian-corp.example
messages.text: This is now one day out and still unowned — can you confirm who's handling it?
